mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM SYS_JOB_RUN_LOG WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND status = 'RUNNING'

SELECT l.id, l.job_id, l.trigger_type, l.reason, l.start_time, l.end_time, l.status, l.created_by, l.created_time, l.scheduled_fire_time, t.status AS process_status, t.error_msg AS error_msg FROM SYS_JOB_RUN_LOG l
LEFT JOIN PERF_METRIC_CALC_TASK t ON t.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = l.id WHERE l.job_id = #{jobId} ORDER BY l.created_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
